POWER OF ATTORNEY

Know all by these presents, that the undersigned hereby constitutes and appoints
each of Milton C. Ault, III and David J. Katzoff, signing singly, the
undersigned's true and lawful attorney-in-fact to execute Forms 3, 4 and 5.
